note: Defects found while writing docs/strategy/sitemap.md (F1-F9) and docs/engineering/architecture.md (A1-A6), each checked against the code by running its functions.

findings.title: sitemap.xml omits six corporate pages and 12 of 14 stories (36 URLs)
findings.evidence: src/lib/seo/site-routes.ts reads CORPORATE_PAGES and NEWS_ITEMS instead of CORPORATE_SECTIONS and the media stories (sitemap.md F1)
findings.expected: every prerendered page appears in sitemap.xml in both locales
findings.suggested_fix: read the same registries the corporate routes use

findings.title: Canonical and hreflang links only on /offline
findings.evidence: only the offline page puts canonical and alternate links in the head (sitemap.md F2)
findings.expected: every page declares a canonical URL and en/ms alternates
findings.suggested_fix: add alternates to the shared metadata helpers and adopt them in layouts

findings.title: No airline-to-terminal lookup; concierge misses "Which terminal does AirAsia use?"
findings.evidence: there is no airline directory and the concierge does not recognise the question, though it answers a check-in phrasing (sitemap.md F3)
findings.expected: airline and terminal questions answered from the airline records with sources
findings.suggested_fix: add an airline-terminal intent using AirlineAtAirport records; consider a small airline list on the airport overview

findings.title: Home shop and dine filters lost after choosing an airport
findings.evidence: filters ticked on the home Shop & dine block are dropped when the visitor then chooses an airport (sitemap.md F4)

findings.title: Search: "fast track" returns nothing; "halal" ranks unrelated help answers above the halal outlet
findings.expected: common service queries return the relevant item first
findings.suggested_fix: add synonyms and boosts; index fast track where content mentions it

findings.title: /{airport}/map and /{airport}/transit answer for every airport but are not linked or listed
findings.evidence: pages exist for all 39 airports as empty states (sitemap.md F6)

findings.title: Legacy Wi-Fi and KLIA rental pages redirect permanently to pages without that content
findings.evidence: 308 redirects to destinations with no Wi-Fi or rental content (sitemap.md F7)
findings.expected: permanent redirects only to equivalent content; otherwise the closest relevant page with a temporary redirect
findings.suggested_fix: re-point to the facilities page filtered to Wi-Fi and to the transport page car-rental section, or use 307

findings.title: Breadcrumb structured-data helper unused
findings.evidence: the helper exists in src/lib/seo but no page emits BreadcrumbList (sitemap.md F8)
findings.suggested_fix: emit it from the Breadcrumbs component

findings.title: Inconsistent Malay name for the concierge
findings.suggested_fix: choose one term (pending native review) across dictionaries

findings.title: JavaScript per page 294-312 KB gzip, over the 250 KB budget
findings.evidence: measured from the build: a zod chunk of about 33 KB and the demo flight generator ship to the browser (architecture.md)
findings.expected: each page at or under 250 KB gzip JavaScript
findings.suggested_fix: keep zod schemas server-only (validate at build), lazy-load the demo provider where flights are shown, audit client components

findings.title: No CI configuration for the app
findings.evidence: no workflow runs typecheck, lint, unit, build, e2e or axe (architecture.md)
findings.expected: a CI workflow scoped to malaysia-airports/
findings.suggested_fix: add .github/workflows/malaysia-airports-ci.yml limited to pull requests and manual runs with paths filter malaysia-airports/**; a clean checkout needs next typegen before tsc

findings.title: Playwright runs Chromium only
findings.suggested_fix: add a WebKit phone project if the browser is available; otherwise document

findings.title: Service worker cache names are not build-versioned; security.md says they are
findings.evidence: cache names carry v1, not a build id (architecture.md)
findings.suggested_fix: version caches with the build id or correct the document

findings.title: Demo queue-time provider exists but no page shows queue times
findings.evidence: benchmarks Istanbul and Incheon show live waits; the provider is unused (architecture.md)
findings.expected: either shown, demo-labelled, where it helps the journey, or removed from health
findings.suggested_fix: show demo-labelled security and immigration waits on the flight detail and airport overview
